elaine: Quick sync — Apollo marketplace co-marketing. Need: 1) webinar date + host + CTA; 2) benchmark narrative outline for blog; 3) inbound lead routing + SFDC form mapping; 4) final social copy. Can we lock by EOD Thursday?

sam: I'm +1 for Tue 4/5pm PT. That slot works for our APAC too?

rohan: Tue works. I'll confirm with Apollo PM. I'll handle marketplace listing copy.

mara: I'll draft blog benchmark narrative. Need raw perf numbers and customer quote. @kevin can you drop the latency/cost table?

kevin: dropping numbers now: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/EXAMPLE (perf sheet)

kevin: sample table below:
```text
model | tokens/sec | p95 latency | $/k tokens
gptx-8 | 320 | 42ms | $1.8
open-7 | 210 | 65ms | $1.1
```

mara: perfect. I'll shape this into a 700-900 word narrative + 2 visuals. ETA Wed noon.

lina: For webinar GTM, recommend a registration page with 2CTAs: demo request + partner listing. I'll build form and map to SFDC campaign "ApolloLaunchQ2". Need lead routing rules: demo leads -> SDR queue; marketplace interest -> partner-ops.

rohan: noted. I'll create the partner-ops queue and share mapping.

elaine: +1. Also need a short benchmark TL;DR for social. @mara can you produce 280 char and 3 alt headlines?

mara: yes — I'll add to the doc. Drafts: https://notion.so/example-notion

sam: Quick ask — can we have a 30-min dry run a day before? ops-bot can schedule.

ops-bot: Scheduling poll created: https://when2meet.com/example-poll

kevin: FYI: quantized model variance might change numbers by ~5%. Put a note in blog.

mara: added note.

elaine: ok targets: lock webinar date by EOD Thu, blog draft Wed EOD, social by Thu morning, lead mapping live Fri. Assign owners: webinar host - sam, blog - mara, listing - rohan, forms - lina, perf numbers - kevin. Anything else?

sam: I'll own host + slide deck. Need slides template.

mara: templates in /drive/marketing/templates/apollo-slides.pptx

rohan: Apollo asked for a joint customer quote — I can ask their PM for intros.

lina: once form ready, I'll share mapping CSV.

elaine: thanks all. I'll follow up with a 1-paragraph external comms blurb tomorrow.

kevin: +1
